main_text.head: DE POENITENTIA, THESIS.
main_text.p: Exhortatione ad veram poenitentiam,Lectio 9. nunquam non opus est.f.Octobr.
Rationes thesin hanc munientes, εὐλ-[?] λαβῶς[?] ita complecti licebit.
1. Quia Deus omnibus utriusq; Testamenti ministris in mandatis dedit, ut prę dicarent poenitentiam & remissionē peccatorū in nomine Christi. Luc.24.46.47.[illegible, ~4 letters]

2. Quia ascendit malitia hominum inπροκ[illegible, ~5 letters] conspectum Iehouae.Ionae 1.2. Item:Voxκλαγ[?] sanguinis clamat ad Deum è terra. Gen. 4.10. Item: Clamor Sodomae & Gomorrhae multiplicatus est coram me, & peccatum aggrauatum.Gen.18.20.
3. Quia iudicaturus est orbem iustè,ne quis non resipiscentium se excusabilem esse putet,denunciat omnibus ubiq; hominibus ut resipiscant.Actor.17.30.31.
4. Quia quid sibi pœnæ & castigatio-nes publicæ & privatæ velint, praeconiū poenitentiæ testari debet.

head.i: Quot modis denunciat Deus hominibus ut resipiscant?

main_text.p: Duobus potisimùm, Verbo nimirum & Facto. Utroq; sanè palàm fit ira Dei è coelo.

page.notes: Greek epigraph and the Greek marginal words are uncertain and are marked [?] or left illegible. The right-margin note near "Testamenti" and the note beside "malitia" could not be read reliably. The hyphen after "castigatio" and "Gomorrhae" is as printed. Printed "Thef." in the epigraph reference was read as "Thes." because long s is a plain s. Catchword "coelo" and signature "C 4" are read from the foot right and are uncertain. The printed "remifsionē" was read as "remissionē" and "afcendit" as "ascendit".
